SELECT c.room_id, c.status, c.latest_message, c.latest_at, c.expires_at, t.title AS training_title, CASE WHEN #{userId} = c.user_id THEN trainer.username ELSE trainee.username END AS opponent_name, CASE WHEN #{userId} = c.user_id THEN trainer.user_profile_url ELSE trainee.user_profile_url END AS opponent_profile_url FROM counselings c JOIN users trainee ON trainee.user_id = c.user_id JOIN users trainer ON trainer.user_id = c.trainer_id JOIN trainings t ON t.training_id = c.training_id
WHERE #{userId} IN (c.user_id, c.trainer_id) ORDER BY c.latest_at DESC
SELECT * FROM counselings WHERE room_id = #{roomId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counselings ( user_id, trainer_id, training_id, room_id, status, latest_message, latest_at, start_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{trainerId}, #{trainingId}, #{roomId}, #{status}, #{latestMessage}, #{latestAt}, #{startAt}, #{expiresAt} )
